xwikidoc.title: Content Expiry
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity}} Content Expiry lists, and in later versions deletes, pages that nobody has changed for a set time, after warning their owners.
#if ($hasAdmin) * [[Settings>>path:$xwiki.getURL('XWiki.XWikiPreferences', 'admin', 'editor=globaladmin&section=contentExpiry')]] * [[Report>>path:$xwiki.getURL('XWiki.XWikiPreferences', 'admin', 'editor=globaladmin&section=contentExpiryReport')]] #else Wiki administrators configure it under Administration, Content. #end {{/velocity}}
